BiblicalUsage: Seren is a lord, a ruler — the title of the five Philistine lords who ruled the coastal cities. They gathered to decide what to do with the ark of God, and they watched it go back to Israel. The same word also means an axle, and it is used for the axles under the great bronze bases in Solomon's temple.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the Philistine lords show the limit of earthly power: five rulers in council could not decide what to do with the ark of God. God lets rulers scheme, and His ark does not answer to them.
